# Step - to_list

`to_list` · `toList` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Runs the traversal and returns all results as a list.

## Forms

```text
to_list()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().has_label("software").values("name").to_list()   // ["lop", "ripple"]
```

- [Displaying Results](../../users_guide/displaying_results.md)
